review:
Multi Rush is a retro cluster slot from BGaming and Perfect Position, full of fruit symbols and a few cheeky aubergine surprises. Electric Wins and random Rush multipliers up to 100x add excitement to the base game.

Three bonus buy options are available where permitted: Hyper Spins, in which every cell starts with a 64x multiplier, plus Bonus and Super Bonus. Another option raises your chance of triggering the bonus by more than 300%. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 10,000x maximum and a 96.15% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 226 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
